card.text: Explore Kriemhild in 3D with its published shape model and radial elevation.

introduction.text: Convex light-curve reconstruction. The grid marks unavailable surface imagery.

shape.title: DAMIT 621 shape model
shape.summary: Convex light-curve reconstruction with approximate thermal size: 45.14 km effective diameter (catalog ±0.51 km; additional shape and thermal-model uncertainty). Thermal size is used as a volume-scale approximation. Both pole solutions remain possible. The grid marks unavailable imagery; rotational phase is illustrative.

elevation.title: DAMIT 621 radial height
elevation.summary: Radius on the shape model minus a 22.57 km reference sphere, in false color. Heights inherit the size uncertainty; this is not independent topography or gravitational height.
